description: LiNaCeWO₆ crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. The structure consists of four Li clusters inside a NaCeWO₆ framework. In each Li cluster, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaCeWO₆ framework, Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Ce is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ce-O bond lengths are 2.23 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.95 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ce, and one W atom.
